answer: Fake identities would wander across the network unnoticed, gaining no attestations, and any whisper of collusion between linked accounts triggers slashing of the full bond. Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted reputation with slashing: each agent bonds tokens before joining, and peers attest only to work they verified. The cost of forging identities then falls like timber, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0280's threat model.
